newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late rubber unchanged in dull trade.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late rubber unchanged in dull trade.

text.p: Indonesian rubber prices were unchanged in late trading on Monday as selling pressure mounted amid weak demand, dealers said.
They said tyre-grade SIR20 remained at 56.00-56.25 cents/lb fob Medan, 55.50-55.75 cents fob Palembang, Padang and Surabaya, 55.125 cents fob Jambi and 55.00 cents fob Pontianak.
"There were no trades or enquiries today," one Medan dealer said. "I expected firmer Tokyo futures today to help lift local prices but there has been nothing yet."
Tokyo futures closed firmer across the board on Monday on news of a sharp decline in Japan's rubber stocks.
Another trader said SIR20 was heard done at 56.00-56.25 cents/lb fob Medan last Friday. He said the purchases were made by U.S. agents but did not have details of the offtakes.
A Jakarta dealer said there were bids by U.S. buyers in Palembang but no deals had been done yet.
December RSS1 was last done at 126 cents/kg fob Medan, where SIR10 was on offer at 57.50 cents/lb.
